claude.rationale: The slice documents no in-window (~2016–2018) public record: the registrant's last 10-K was FY2013, it delisted (Form 25-NSE, March 2015) and deregistered (Form 15-12B, October 2015) before the outcome window opened, so no audited outcome record exists. The pre-window trajectory (FY2013 net loss of $400.2M, a program to close up to 1,100 stores, and a Feb 5, 2015 Chapter 11 filing) describes overall financial distress but contains no evidence isolating a product/process interface disruption (p4) or a process/organization fracture (p5). Because the specific interfaces cannot be determined from the documented distress and no in-window record is observable, both p4 and p5 are coded uncertain.
